peerGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

positions.label: Resale activity
positions.statement: Resale activity — Around peers (62.4): 3.7 resales per 100 homes a year (24 months): higher than 164 of 266 similar developments with a figure (the same as 4). Initial resale-wave effect: 1 of the 3 resales in Oct 2024–Sep 2026 came in the first 12 months of the resale wave (Oct 2024–Feb 2025); the sustained rate is shown separately. The wave start is based on the analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date. Context, not scored: resales in 12.5% of months (24 months).

comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (OCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity
lines.statement: 3.1 resales per 100 homes a year over 19 months (Mar 2025–Sep 2026): higher than 136 of 258 similar developments. First resale wave from Mar 2024 (analytical proxy: the month recorded resales first reach 2% of homes; not an official MOP date). Observed 24-month activity: 3.7.

lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 1 other condo development sold new homes within 2 km (Vela Bay, 386 new sales, about 1,590 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 178 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 386 new sales and 558 resales (944 purchases); new sales were 40.9% of these purchases. Subsales (13) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 558 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 584 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−4.5%). Planning-area private resales −7.9%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
